verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents its own headless control surfaces: a public REST API for programmatic control alongside orchestrators like Airflow, a Terraform provider for configuration-as-code, the abctl CLI for managing instances, and PyAirbyte for running syncs from Python. These cover headless automation well, but nothing in the evidence documents running Airbyte inside a CI pipeline, so CI coverage is only implied. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI usage), non-interactive/headless mode guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Airbyte API to programmatically interact with Airbyte. For example, you can control Airbyte in conjunction with orchestration tools like Airflow.
you can use Airbyte's Terraform provider to automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code
abctl is Airbyte's open source command line tool to create and manage local instances of Airbyte running in Docker.
PyAirbyte brings the power of Airbyte to every Python and AI developer.
